[[File:Sulcasky.png|thumb|right|180px|A billboard advertisement for Sulcasky! (left), next to a mirror-inverted [[Cabaret poster/Legends|cabaret advertisement]] (middle) and an [[Soda (advertisement)/Legends|advertisement for soda]] (right).]]
{{Quote|Sulcasky! <br />An exhibition|Sulcasky! advertisement|<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>}}
'''Sulcasky!''' was an exhibition held on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore" /> and [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]<ref name="Mystery">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Sulcasky! An Exhibition/Legends|Posters and advertisements]] were put up on various public places in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]],<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore" /> and in [[Cliffhold]] on Iego,<ref name="Mystery" /> to promote it. The advertisement showed a kneeling figure and [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text.<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sulcasky! advertisement first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Mystery of a Thousand Moons]]."<ref name="Mystery" />
